# TabM — một model cho mọi xe

<!-- generated by scripts/experiments_status.py from scenarios.json + results.csv; do not edit -->

- **Model:** TabM raw numeric, 77 → 32 → 32 → 16, k = 4 member chung trọng số; 6.548 tham số, dropout 0,1.
- **Code:** core/tabm.py, scripts/run_fl.py --backbone tabm; centralized: scripts/run_central_backbones.py --model tabm
- **Protocol:** 5.343 xe nhận = 5.343 client, mọi client mỗi round, 1 epoch local trên fold train + val, 50 round, batch 64, AdamW cosine 1e-3 → 1e-5; centralized 50 epoch, batch 4.096. Headline = round 50 (CANPerFL: 10 epoch fine-tune sau FedAvg r50), view theo bài gốc. [protocol](../../docs/research/protocol.md)
- **Tài liệu:** [tabm-single-model-baselines](../../docs/research/backbones/tabm-single-model-baselines.md), [four-backbone-seed-results-live](../../docs/research/backbones/four-backbone-seed-results-live.md), [aligned-fl-v2](../../docs/research/aligned-fl-v2.md)
